    12  /-!
    13  # Rank and torsion
    14  
    15  ## Main statements
    16  
    17  - `rank_quotient_eq_of_le_torsion` : `rank M/N = rank M` if `N ≤ torsion M`.
    18  - `finrank_quotient_eq_of_le_torsion` : `finrank M/N = finrank M` if `N ≤ torsion M`.
    19  - `finrank_quotient_torsion_eq` : `finrank ℤ (M / torsion M) = finrank ℤ M` for an additive
    20    commutative group `M`.
    21  -/
    22  
    23  public section
    24  
    25  open Submodule
    26  
    27  theorem rank_quotient_eq_of_le_torsion {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    28      {M' : Submodule R M} (hN : M' ≤ torsion R M) : Module.rank R (M ⧸ M') = Module.rank R M :=
    29    (rank_quotient_le M').antisymm <| by
    30      nontriviality R
    31      rw [Module.rank]
    32      refine ciSup_le fun ⟨s, hs⟩ ↦ LinearIndependent.cardinal_le_rank (v := (M'.mkQ ·)) ?_
    33      rw [LinearIndepOn, linearIndependent_iff'] at hs
    34      simp_rw [linearIndependent_iff', ← map_smul, ← map_sum, mkQ_apply, Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
    35      intro t g hg i hi
    36      obtain ⟨r, hg⟩ := hN hg
    37      simp_rw [Finset.smul_sum, Submonoid.smul_def, smul_smul] at hg
    38      exact r.prop.2 _ (mul_comm (g i) r ▸ hs t _ hg i hi)
    39  
    40  theorem finrank_quotient_eq_of_le_torsion {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    41      {M' : Submodule R M} (hN : M' ≤ torsion R M) :
    42      Module.finrank R (M ⧸ M') = Module.finrank R M :=
    43    congr_arg Cardinal.toNat (rank_quotient_eq_of_le_torsion hN)
    44  
    45  /-- Quotienting an additive commutative group by its torsion subgroup does not change its
    46  `ℤ`-`finrank`. -/
    47  theorem finrank_quotient_torsion_eq {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] :
    48      Module.finrank ℤ (M ⧸ (AddCommGroup.torsion M).toIntSubmodule) = Module.finrank ℤ M :=
    49    finrank_quotient_eq_of_le_torsion <| le_of_eq <| by
    50      rw [← Submodule.torsion_int, Submodule.toAddSubgroup_toIntSubmodule]
